title: CBOR map with an integer key

source.clause: §7.1 CBOR format; ECMA-430 §5 ("as defined in ECMA-404")
source.note: composed: RFC 8949 §3.1 allows a map key of any type, while an ECMA-404 object's names are strings and §5 makes an NLIP message an ECMA-404 object. The structured payload here is the CBOR map {1: "x"}, which no JSON document could hold. The bytes come from conformance/tools/cbor_encode.py with the `$map` marker.

notes: A peer that keys a map by integer for compactness is doing something CBOR permits; the message is refused because re-encoding it as JSON would mean inventing a spelling for that key.
